title: Verdant Circlet Studs
metal: 18k gold tone (PVD 18K gold over surgical stainless steel), bright high-polish mirror finish; one tone only
lock: Each 16.8mm stud, 18k gold tone: 1 tilted cushion-cut deep green cubic zirconia (10mm) in a polished collet sits at 12 o'clock over a hollow circlet about 14mm wide. Clockwise round the circlet: 1 clear cubic zirconia, 1 large white shell pearl at 3 o'clock, 2 clear stones, 1 plain four-point star, 1 small pearl, 1 clear stone, 1 star centred with a clear stone. The pair mirror each other. The circlet must stay hollow and lopsided under the stone (big pearl one side, small pearl and stars the other), never a symmetric halo with the green stone in its centre. Metal: 18k gold tone, high polish.
morph: The lopsided hollow circlet under the green stone. Image models move the green stone into the middle of a closed, symmetric halo; fill or close the open centre; even out the pearls (2 same-size pearls, or a ring of pearls); drop the 2 four-point stars or turn them into round stones; or make the 2 studs identical instead of mirror images. Second risk: the green stone gets centred on the circle or turned into a step-cut emerald shape instead of a tilted faceted cushion.
sizeMm: Height 16.8mm (listing and size guide, 'give or take 1 mm'). Green cushion cubic zirconia about 10mm (listing). Width is not listed; from the size guide's 10mm scale bar I estimate about 14mm across the circlet. The listing says the large white shell pearl is about 6mm, but against that scale bar it measures nearer 4 to 4.5mm, about half the green stone's width. The small pearl is about 2 to 2.5mm, and the clear stones are about 2.5mm (estimated). Body referent: in worn photo 02 the green stone sits on the earlobe and the circlet hangs just below it, so the whole stud is about the height of an adult earlobe, roughly 1.5 fingernail widths tall.
claims: Waterproof, Tarnish Free, Hypoallergenic. All three are tags, and the description also says 'Waterproof and tarnish free' and 'PVD 18K gold coating, anti-tarnish'. Material: surgical stainless steel.
copyNotes: Use: 'green cubic zirconia', 'deep green', 'white shell pearl', 'open circlet', 'little stars', '18k gold tone', 'PVD', 'surgical stainless steel', '16.8mm', 'stud', 'waterproof', 'tarnish free', 'hypoallergenic', 'one bold ear', 'hair up'. Avoid: 'emerald' as a stone, including 'emerald-green cubic zirconia' (the listing itself says 'green cubic zirconia, not emerald'; in a prompt the word also pulls a step-cut emerald shape). Avoid 'pearl' without 'shell', and 'freshwater', 'real' or 'natural' pearl. Also avoid 'diamond', 'gemstone', 'solid gold', 'gold-filled', bare 'gold', 'huggie', 'hoop', 'drop', 'dangle', 'jhumka' (it is a fixed stud on a post) and 'halo' (the stone sits on top of the circle, not inside it). Do not count pearls in copy: the listing copy says 1 pearl 'inside the circle', but the photos show 2 pearls per stud (1 large, 1 small) set on the circlet. The listing has no 'Pearl' tag.
story: Colour above, soft white below: a deep green cushion stone like a small moon resting on a wreath of sparkle, pearls and two little stars. It gives the emerald-and-pearl heirloom look of a grandmother's wedding set, in cubic zirconia at Rs 899. It rhymes with wedding-function green (mehendi, green Banarasi silk, bridal red with a green accent) and with night-sky motifs (moon and stars, festive diyas). It is a statement stud that does the work of a jhumka without the weight: one bold ear, hair up, plain neckline (the listing's own styling tip). Earlier best archetypes: OCCASION (wedding function, Banarasi), sage colour camp, true-size WORN ear, MACRO of the circlet.
variants: One variant only: Default Title, 18k gold tone, stock 32, so every photo shows this variant. Listing media: 01 is the packshot on a plaster cube, with the left stud face-on (clearest whole construction) and the right stud angled to show the post and the open-window collet. 02 is worn on the ear in profile (scale only; the stud is too small in frame to carry construction, and the alt text says true 16.8 mm size). 03 shows both studs from above on the cube with both circlets face-up, which shows the mirror layout. 04 is the blush Naira Petite gift box (no earrings). 05 is the size guide: photo 01 with a 16.8mm height line and a 10mm scale bar overlaid (do not use as a reference, the text would leak). Show 01 as the construction authority and 03 for the mirrored pair. Use 02 only to judge scale in worn shots. Refs 01 and 03 are pixel-identical to the ads-500 pack and detail refs, so their earlier media ids are reused.
